## Activity

During December 2020, East City Eye Clinic recorded 91 captures. This represents the activity completed at the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. The activity record indicates that the clinic maintained a clear account of completed imaging for the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.2. This result identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and should be considered alongside the overall activity recorded for December 2020. The image-quality outcome is reported separately to distinguish capture volume from the usability of the images obtained.

## Grading

Grading identified 12 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides the central measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading during the reporting period. Together, the grading findings and the median lag summarise the clinical review activity associated with the 91 captures at East City Eye Clinic.
